title: CriteriaTrialRequest
description: BFF -> core API input for the criteria hearing's "Try it" and for assessing a change to the agreed line (ADR-165 D3 / D6). Carries the end users' line — each end user's QCD + S ratio and, per value-tree element, the expectation (criterion) and the weight of exceeding it. The solver turns it into candidate cells, each end user's interest per category, and — when a proposed line is given — what the change gives up. Wire form uses camelCase.

proposedLine.description: The line as a proposal would leave it. Present = assess the change (the response's `proposal` is then not `notAsked`).

line.description: Every end user whose answers are complete. An end user with blanks is not sent (the front's census counts them; the solver never guesses a blank).

elements.description: One entry per value-tree element — all seven, each exactly once (uniqueness is checked by the solver; a duplicate is a 400).

mix.description: The end user's ratio between Delivery, Quality, Cost and Safety. Not all zero (checked by the solver).

elementKey.description: The value tree's lower tier (ADR-165 D2). The front's CriteriaCatalog and core's catalog are both held to this enum by conformance tests.
